# Test fixtures

Archives written by other implementations, read here to check that ours reads
them as they were written. Both are copied unchanged from the `fixtures/`
directory of the `pmtiles` crate, version 0.24.0 (MIT OR Apache-2.0).

| File | Original name | What it exercises | Data licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `leaf.pmtiles` | `leaf.pmtiles` | leaf directories | — (synthetic) |
| `raster-z3.pmtiles` | `stamen_toner(raster)CC-BY+ODbL_z3.pmtiles` | a PNG raster pyramid, z0–z3 | map tiles CC BY 3.0; data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL |
